audit: every new source four views vs every old source four views
denominator_policy: Exclude whole new source if ANY view matches ANY old view. Within-new collisions stay entirely within this confirmation partition; retain source-level denominator and report collisions, never treat 4N transformed instances as independent source samples.
hash_representation: SHA256 of 64 row-major uint8 counts in 0..16; labels and task names excluded

transformations.left: one-column left shift, final column zero
transformations.right: one-column right shift, first column zero
